$comment: QUARANTINE LEDGER for direction 3 of scripts/audit/ci-pinned-tests-exist.mjs
(cinatra#2439). A packages/** test file with no statically detected CI runner
turns that gate RED unless it is named here. This is the ONLY no-runner state
the contract admits: a quarantined suite runs nowhere, so it MUST carry a filed
follow-up issue. The other contract state — main-only — is not an exception at
all: such a suite still executes and still reds its check, so the gate detects
its runner like any other. There is no third state.
Every entry is validated by readPackageSuiteExceptions(): `file` must be a
tracked packages/** test path, `kind` must be "quarantine", `issue` must be a
GitHub issue URL, and `reason` must be a written sentence. An entry whose file
is GONE, or whose file a runner DOES execute, fails the gate — a ledger that
does not describe CI's actual shape is worse than none.
Retiring an entry: repair the suite, delete its exclusion from the package's
vitest.config.ts AND its entry here in the same change, and close the issue.
The exclusion and the entry are a PAIR; the gate's redundant-entry check is
what stops one from outliving the other.
